analogs.covers: Life: a cliff-dwelling band that escapes onto ledges, with bossy females and ledge fights

headline: A mountain goat band on the cliffs, with bighorn rams' head-butting duels.

setting.label: Mountains, cliffs, ledges and caves
setting.note: Thrives in mountainous regions and travels along migratory paths, but settles around a chosen rock, cliff or cave. Flighty on open terrain.

playsLike: You are a small daytime herbivore in a 'band' of unlimited females with one adult buck. You claim an elevated rock, cliff or cave and defend 10 body lengths around it. The whole band may fight, but it should retreat onto a ledge, rock or cave whenever it can. Leader and follower personalities shape the band; disputes are settled with kicks and headbutts, and knocking a rival off a ledge is humiliation enough. Your stats are adjusted to make you a true rock jumper.

why.text: Flighty on open terrain and retreats to perched rocks, cliffs and caves when threatened. That is how mountain goats escape (official inspiration).
Females run a soft hierarchy of 'leader' personalities and even bully the buck. Mountain goat nannies dominate the billies as well.
A well-aimed kick or headbutt sends a rival stumbling off the ledge.
Duels for the lead-buck position and the dome-headed fighting style are bighorn-ram territory.
Small tier, 2,000 combat weight, sprint 1,050 held for 167 s, with stats tuned for rock jumping.

notLike: Mountain goats stab with their horns rather than ramming heads; the dome-bashing comes from bighorn sheep.
It eats berries, but also carrion and bones.
